inputs.CREATION_REQUEST: Create and validate the terraform-ansible-managed-resources Terminus task as a production-characteristic Terraform Plugin Framework provider with exactly ten managed resources. Create, Update and Delete mutations use Ansible; Read/refresh observes native Linux state without side effects. Terraform Core is the sole durable state authority. Preserve stable external-object identities, drift reconciliation, failure-safe update/delete retry semantics, scoped ownership/deletion, runner argv/timeout/cancellation/cleanup safety, canonical normalization/idempotency, and complete solver-visible provider/resource/lifecycle contracts.
